decisions.reason: Its own page and positive agency-focused feedback suggest promising option value, and as a software add-on close to the established offer its carrying cost is likely low.
As the flagship platform promoted on the home page and central to the firm's stated direction, its option value remains high and dropping it would abandon a key growth option.
A configurable managed hosting plan close to the core offer with its own page implies low incremental cost and continued fit with current customers, so the option is worth keeping.

Launched only in 2024 and still only mentioned on the site, its prospects remain uncertain, but since it builds on the established offer and likely costs little to maintain, the firm should keep the option while learning.
